# Legacy character-contract fixture

`SRD-Lite-117-QA-Legacy-Contract-Clean.sylvia-gm-package` is a derived test fixture for the
legacy 0.3.0 character contract. It is not an original release archive and is not bundled
as current playable content. Its runtime, participant schemas, source corpus and notices
retain the original bytes. A nonfunctional source locator uses a portable spelling, and
its catalogue pointer and archive manifest hashes are recomputed through normal admission.

The 0.3.0 version is retained to exercise the exact existing legacy migration boundary.
Original archive bytes and evidence remain in the preserved preceding source snapshot.
Existing installed packages and campaign pins are not modified by this test fixture.
